description: Serves final-failure precedence from the same 8.3 bullet as callback exceptions. Three keys arrange the three reasons in different orders across a two-locale chain: Mixed.NoMatchThenFailure misses its alternatives in Russian and then raises in English; Mixed.FailureThenNoMatch raises in Russian and then misses in English; Mixed.MissingThenNoMatch is absent from Russian and misses in English. DefaultStrings.java:742-746 computes the reported reason from firstFallbackFailure and the sticky noMatchingAlternativeEncountered flag rather than from the last attempt, so a port that reports the last -- or the first -- attempt's reason diverges on at least one of these. Two loaded locales with distinct primary languages, so tiebreakers are null.

Mixed.NoMatchThenFailure.commentary: Alternatives-only, and the predicate is false for the counts the cases pass.

Mixed.FailureThenNoMatch.commentary: Only ONE is translated, so a Russian FEW count (2) raises here.

Mixed.NoMatchThenFailure.commentary: Only ONE is translated, so an English OTHER count (2) raises here.

Mixed.FailureThenNoMatch.commentary: Alternatives-only miss, reached only when the policy keeps walking past the Russian raise.

Mixed.MissingThenNoMatch.commentary: Absent from Russian entirely, so the chain is MISSING_TRANSLATION then NO_MATCHING_ALTERNATIVE.
